summary: An isolated textBox contract example linked to Gramlot's existing gnr-textbox implementation.

parameters.name: placeholder
parameters.doc: Hint shown while the field has no text.

parameters.name: disabled
parameters.doc: Disable editing; a string also permits the existing ^/= binding syntax.

parameters.name: readonly
parameters.doc: Make the inner input read-only; a string also permits ^/= binding.

integration.binding: Gramlot resolves literal, ^ and = recipe values before rendering; value write-back follows updateOn.
integration.form: The shared form service reads node identity, validation attributes and value changes; this component does not own persistence.

lifecycle.connected: Synchronize host attributes, connect null-state behavior and start label observation.
lifecycle.disconnected: Disconnect the WidgetLabel observer so detached fields retain no observer callback.

status: Worked example only; this descriptor format is not a frozen public Gramlot API.
